content.comment_body: Hello, I had [product_name] software installed on an office laptop. Unfortunately, the laptop's motherboard failed, and with service centers closed due to COVID-19, repairs weren't possible. Also, the [company_name] distributor in my area didn't provide a software CD, saying installation required a visit to their office. Are there any free software alternatives for programming a [product_name] controller and setting its IP address?
To my knowledge, there are no alternatives available.
Is it possible to digitally download the [product_name] software? I'm willing to pay if needed.
For a licensed full version, no direct download is available. You may be able to purchase the software online, for example via Amazon.

Sadly, in India it seems nobody is selling [product_name] software online. When I purchased a [product_name] [article_no], should a software CD have been included? The distributor didn't give me one, and told me to bring my laptop to their office for installation. Is it possible distributors are withholding software to resell for profit?
As far as I know, [product_name] hardware is sold without software and the software has to be purchased separately.

A few questions to help with your situation: 1. Can you remove the hard disk from the broken computer? 2. Do you have an external reader or another PC to access the disk? 3. Which files could be extracted to enable software upgrade? Also, here is an alternative link: [url]

Yes, I can do that next. I have an external hard disk case for 2.5" disks (essentially a USB-to-SATA adapter) used for these situations. I think I'll be able to retrieve the software, but I'm unsure if its license is bound to the motherboard, like some Windows licenses are.

I don't quite understand the question. If you have the official CD or DVD that licenses your installation, you can upgrade. If not, I would not advise on this topic. Otherwise, you should submit a support request.
Hello. There's an official FAQ for moving licensed software for [product_name] ([version_no]), but I'm unaware of a legal method for [product_name].

I don't know all [company_name] FAQs, but I haven't seen any for [product_name]. I also can't advise on this, since suggestions could risk enabling unlicensed installation. Please don't ask me about such matters in future.

Hello. There is an official FAQ for transferring licensed [product_name] software ([version_no]). I'm hoping there's also a legal way for [product_name]. That's what I'm after: the ability to legally move my license from the damaged laptop to a new one.

The [product_name] license is actually the CD or DVD-ROM. You can install [product_name] as many times as you want if you have the CD/DVD. If it's lost, a new disk must be purchased. It's more economical to simply buy this low-cost software than spend hours trying to create a license without the original disk. Regards, [user_name]

I see. Money isn't the issue. I could go to the distributor for a CD anytime, but the risk with COVID-19 is too high, especially since cases are increasing rapidly in my state. If they offered online sales, it would be helpful, but I guess I'll have to visit the distributor. How much should it cost in India? There are many dishonest sellers.
I cannot provide price information for India. In Germany, the CD price varies depending on where you purchase it but is typically around €55 (about 4827 Indian rupees).
I understand your concerns, but the core problem is the missing CD/DVD-ROM, not COVID-19. I can't believe there's no shipment option for the software in India. Regards, [user_name]

Thank you! I ended up paying a similar amount plus an extra thousand rupees. The CD wasn't lost, I simply didn't receive one with my [product_name] [article_no] controller. Is it normal for the software not to come bundled with the controller?

[product_name] software that's installed and previously used should keep working. You can move the hard drive to a different laptop and continue using it. Creating a disk image could help in case the drive fails again.

It's interesting—you never received a CD, yet you have [product_name] software with a license on your broken laptop? The order number only covers the base module, so software isn't included. There are starter packs available that bundle both hardware and software. With that, I consider this topic resolved. [user_name]

Sir, the [product_name] software is free; you can download it from the [company_name] website. First download [product_name] [version_no] and install it, then download [product_name] [version_no] and install that.
That's not correct. [product_name] software isn't free, only the updates and upgrades are.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties obtaining and reinstalling [product_name] software due to limited options for digital downloads and restricted distributor assistance during the COVID-19 lockdown. There is ambiguity about whether the software is provided with hardware purchases, resulting in users needing to visit distributor offices. Concerns were also raised about software licensing potentially being linked to specific hardware components, making recovery and reinstallation uncertain.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want easy access to [product_name] software, ideally as a digital download, and clear information about whether it's included with hardware purchases. They expect to be able to reinstall and use the software without extra steps or restrictions, and without confusion caused by unclear licensing practices.
